newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi bans livestock imports from three countries.
newsitem.headline: Saudi bans livestock imports from three countries.

text.p: Saudi Arabia imposed a temporary ban on livestock imports from Malaysia, Senegal and China, a Ministry of Agriculture official said.

"The temporary ban on livestock imports follows reports of foot and mouth disease cases in these countries," the official said in remarks published in the Saudi business daily al-Eqtisadiah on Wednesday.
He said lifting the ban would be subject to reports from international public health organisations confirming livestock in the three countries as free of the disease.
Saudi Arabia on Monday imposed a ban on beef and beef-related products imported from or through Belgium.
It said the move followed evidence that some Belgian companies were exporting banned British beef to the kingdom under false Belgian certificates of origin.
Saudi Arabia, where meat is a major staple for its 18 million population, imposed a ban on British beef in 1996 after scares that mad cow disease affected humans.
